note: The session's web search allowance ran out after the first seven candidates, so the rest were looked up only on pages reachable directly (party pages, court and county sites, campaign sites they link to, Wikipedia). Nothing was found that way for Andrew Lipian, Michelle Kreager, Daryl T. Dennie, Kimberly Ontko, Rick Rodger, Renea Turner, Darnell T. Brewer, Jonathan R. Bradner, Lyndsey A. Stough, Eboney C. Eldridge or Kelly Hunter-Kalagidis; they deserve a second look with search. A Sylvania City Council member named Lyndsey Stough is on that city's own council page, but no page read ties her to the House District 44 race, so nothing is recorded. The Franklin and Lucas County Democratic parties publish their endorsed lists as images; those two endorsements were taken from ballot/lean/oh_endorsements.json, not re-read here.
